items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
items.claim: The LORD spoke to Moses with instructions about leper cleansing

items.quote: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp
items.claim: The priest goes forth out of the camp

items.quote: And the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper
items.claim: The priest examines whether the plague of leprosy has been healed

items.quote: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop
items.claim: The priest commands taking of birds and materials for the person to be cleansed
items.object: two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop

items.quote: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water
items.claim: The priest commands one of the birds to be killed in an earthen vessel over running water
items.place: in an earthen vessel over running water

items.quote: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water
items.claim: The priest takes and dips the living bird, cedar wood, scarlet, and hyssop in the blood of the killed bird
items.object: the living bird, the cedar wood, the scarlet, and the hyssop

items.quote: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times
items.claim: The priest sprinkles seven times upon the person to be cleansed from leprosy
items.object: him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy

items.claim: The priest pronounces the person clean

items.quote: and shall let the living bird loose into the open field
items.claim: The priest releases the living bird into the open field
